rationale: Verified: ConvertToValue (SearchConditionConvertingExpressionVisitor.cs:41-51) emits CASE WHEN c THEN 1 ELSE 0 with no NULL arm, so a hoisted bare condition returns false, not null.
Hypothesis cleared and correctly so: SqlExpression subclasses override Equals/GetHashCode structurally. No actionable content.
Claims provider subclasses fall through to the safe default; true (unmatched types just stop the recursion). Asserts no defect, so no reader value.
Allocation cost considered and dismissed; correct, this is compile-time-per-query-shape work. Nothing to act on.
Correct: only the 'left is null ? right' arm is exercised (mixed_checks); the symmetric arm and binary.Update have no test. Small, symmetric to covered code.
Checked and correctly cleared: this repo has no release-note directory. Pure non-finding.
Confirmed real: line 539 truncates _nullValueColumns to the _nonNullableColumns watermark; line 529 uses the right one. Pre-existing (blame 17a9035ad) but a maintainer should fix it.
Stack-overflow hypothesis raised and correctly dismissed: Visit already recurses the same tree deeper. No new risk, nothing to act on.
Correctly cleared: CaseExpression derives Type/TypeMapping from whenClauses[0].Result, and line 547 already does the identical collapse.
Accurate style asymmetry: `== true` here vs the `is { InstancePropagatesNullability: true }` pattern at 1505/2393. Cosmetic.
Same substance as the reviewer's 'more general than a very local utility to case, plus extensibility for provider-specific expression types'.
Alias/ORDER BY hypothesis checked and cleared; ProjectionExpression carries the alias independently. Asserts no defect.
Verified: optimization5/6/7 keep '// issue #16050' while their baselines are now the optimal SQL; sibling tests 2/3/4 legitimately keep theirs. Comment hygiene.
Same point as the reviewer's rename suggestion for this helper; both object to the noun-phrase name on a collecting method.
Real gap: nothing pins the argumentsPropagateNullability==false guard that keeps COALESCE results from collapsing. A regression test there is worth having.
Index-mismatch hypothesis cleared, and correctly: the ctor throws InconsistentNumberOfArguments (SqlFunctionExpression.cs:215-224) and IsNiladic carries MemberNotNullWhen.
Cache-poisoning hypothesis checked and cleared; parameter nullability is part of the command cache key. No defect asserted.
Claims Not/Negate/Convert is right and IS NULL/IS NOT NULL correctly excluded; that is accurate. States the code is fine.
Verified: all five tests use ~, int +, or string concat, and mixed_checks puts BoolA in the test not the result. The unsound shapes are entirely uncovered.
Seed adequacy checked and cleared. Confirms existing behavior; no action for a maintainer.
True that SQLite gets no SQL baseline for the five new tests, so a silent non-firing would pass there; but the file's selective-override pattern makes this small.
Core point holds (inner CASE collapses first, so no nested DropNotNullChecks recursion), but 'byte-identical' is wrong: string columns vs int columns.
ExclusiveOr considered and correctly dismissed: NULL ^ x is NULL. Asserts the code is fine, which it is.
Names AtTimeZone and Collate (plus Distinct/JsonScalar) as expression types missing from the model — precisely the reviewer's list.
Recursing by node type instead of an operator allowlist is the fail-open the reviewer identifies and asks to be audited across binary operators.
Baseline churn verified sound and no stale baselines found — an accurate all-clear, not a finding.
Method-length observation the finder itself concedes has no nameable consequence beyond other findings. Costs attention only.
Same substance as the reviewer's 'cleaner to return a TRUE expression here' on the `return null; // true` line: null overloaded to mean true.
Correct: Add's return is discarded and recursion is unconditional, so shared subtrees are re-walked and re-hashed. One-line `if (!operands.Add(e)) return;` fix.
'Swapped' overreaches: _with_partial_checks reasonably names checks that only partially cover the result's operands, as the finding itself concedes.
Verified: IsNull (line 1633) returns false for a C# null elseResult, so an ELSE-less CASE is skipped. A missed optimization, correctly labeled as not a defect.
Accurate: the comment describes only the identity case while the code handles conjunctions and partial drops, and the load-bearing invariant is written nowhere.
Searched for stale baselines and found none; an accurate all-clear with no action attached.
Same point as the reviewer's 'this can all be one nice switch statement with pattern matching' on the if/else-if type-dispatch chains.
Local SDK build breakage in an unrelated test project, explicitly unrelated to the diff. Environmental, not reviewable content.
Claims matching only unary NotEqual is sufficient, which is right: unary NotEqual is IS NOT NULL by construction. States the code is fine.
Correct: the new TODO has no tracking issue while nearby deferred work is marked '// issue #16050'. Cosmetic consistency.
Accurate: the whole result subtree is hashed before the test is known to contain any IS NOT NULL. Real but compile-time-only waste; finder rates it minor.
Bitwise And/Or considered and dismissed; correct either way, since SQL bitwise operators return NULL for a NULL operand.
Contract-strengthening claim refuted, correctly: VisitUnary at 2392-2429 already reads the flags in the reverse direction. Reports no defect.
Verified against the code: the test is visited with preserveColumnNullabilityInformation and the restore happens only at 538, so the result really is simplified under the dropped assumption.
Says flag usage matches VisitSqlFunction (line 1505) — true, and an explicit no-finding. Nothing to act on.
Correct: the only unary test uses ~ (ExpressionType.Not); Negate has no test. Small branch-coverage gap in an otherwise symmetric operator set.
Divide-by-zero hypothesis checked and cleared; only IS NOT NULL conjuncts are dropped. No defect asserted.
Concludes ignoring allowOptimizedExpansion is correct, which holds for a rewrite claiming unconditional equivalence. An all-clear.
Accurate but inconsequential: the IsNiladic guard is a compiler-required null check for Arguments; a dedicated test for it would add nothing.
Scoping clarification for another finding (which boolean results stay correct). Accurate, but carries no independent action.
Same substance as the reviewer naming missing expression types for the model; different example (LikeExpression rather than AtTimeZone/Collate).
Correct on the code (NULL AND FALSE = FALSE breaks the invariant) and lands on the same AndAlso/OrElse null-propagation question the reviewer raised on this function.
Same defect the reviewer states: Coalesce is a legal SqlBinaryExpression operator, is not null-propagating, and the unfiltered recursion admits it.
Correct: no new or updated baseline exercises an instance-method function, so this branch is untested. Small, with a concrete test suggested.
Accurate style asymmetry against line 537 in the same method, plus a redundant list allocation. Cosmetic.
The useRelationalNulls:true pattern does exist in this file (20 sites) and the new tests skip it; a reasonable but modest coverage ask.
Correctly cleared: nullable is already true from the NULL else-branch before the early return. States the code is fine.
Verified: the [EntityFrameworkInternal] ctor accepts instance null with instancePropagatesNullability true, and the sibling at 2393 guards Instance: not null. Latent NRE.
Reports a refuted NullReferenceException claim; the refutation is right — C# string concat with null yields empty. No defect asserted.
